title: {p} Fried Rice
steps: Use cold, day-old {s} if you can. Cook the {p} through and set it aside.
Stir-fry the {v} and {spice} in a hot pan, add the {s} and press it flat so it crisps.
Fold the {p} back in, splash on the {sauce} and serve.
tip: Brown rice, or half cauliflower rice, adds fiber without changing the dish.
